newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain shares stable in active week's trade.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain shares stable in active week's trade.

text.p: Bahraini shares ended the week to Thursday little changed in active trade focused on the banking and investment sector, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index edged down to 1,584.46 points from 1,586.03 points the previous week.
Around 11.9 million shares worth 2.2 million dinars ($5.8 million) were traded in the week, up from 5.74 million shares worth 1.2 million dinrs a week earlier.
Shares of 22 of the 39 firms registered on the exchange changed hands in 245 transactions.
The bourse said Bahrain Middle East Bank led the market with around 6.8 million shares worth 708,566 dinars dealt. It ended the week higher at 108 fils from the previous week's 99 fil close.
The bourse said 599,819 National Bank of Bahrain shares worth 244,726 dinar were traded. The share closed on Thursday at 408 fils.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank was quoted two fils lower in the week at 340 fils. Similarly Investcorp was quoted slightly softer at $1.77 from $1.79.
Bahrain's share market is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
